case_details.title: Test Case TC01
case_details.custom_steps:
1. Initiate automated test case generation for a Jira story with complete acceptance criteria. [Test Data: Jira story with valid acceptance criteria] [Acceptance Criteria: End-to-End Automated Test Case Generation and Publication (Positive)]
2. Publish generated test cases to TestRail. [Test Data: Generated test cases] [Acceptance Criteria: End-to-End Automated Test Case Generation and Publication (Positive)]
case_details.custom_expected:
1. Test cases are generated accurately reflecting acceptance criteria.
2. Test cases are published successfully to TestRail.

case_details.title: Test Case TC02
case_details.custom_steps:
1. Attach a Figma design asset link to Jira story. [Test Data: Valid Figma asset URL] [Acceptance Criteria: Ingest Linked Figma Design Asset (Positive)]
2. Validate that asset metadata and preview are visible in Jira. [Test Data: Figma asset attached] [Acceptance Criteria: Ingest Linked Figma Design Asset (Positive)]
case_details.custom_expected:
1. Figma asset is recognized and ingested into the story record.
2. Asset metadata and preview are displayed correctly.

case_details.title: Test Case TC03
case_details.custom_steps: 1. Attempt to generate test cases for a Jira story without acceptance criteria. [Test Data: Jira story with no acceptance criteria] [Acceptance Criteria: Handling Missing Acceptance Criteria in Jira Story (Negative)]
case_details.custom_expected: 1. System displays error or warning indicating missing acceptance criteria.

case_details.title: Test Case TC04
case_details.custom_steps: 1. Attempt to publish test cases to TestRail while the API is offline. [Test Data: TestRail API endpoint unavailable] [Acceptance Criteria: TestRail API Unavailable During Publishing (Negative)]
case_details.custom_expected: 1. System fails gracefully and provides a clear error message.
